values.note: $5 a night for a single family site, $10 for a group site. The Forest Service page's fee box also lists 'Single Site: $7 per night, Group Site: $14 per night', while its own text and recreation.gov's 2026-2027 rate tables say $5 and $10.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145689/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-24 to 2026-12-31 and 2027: PeakNightlyfee 5, PeakGroupNightlyfee 10) + recreation.gov fee description ('sites 2 through 5 are standard nonelectric single sites at $5 per night') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/sedalia-campground ('Single family sites: $5/night. Group sites: $10/night'; fee box 'Single Site: $7 per night / Group Site: $14 per night'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every site is reservation-only on recreation.gov; have a reservation before arrival. Single sites open 6 months out, group site 1 12 months out. 14 nights in any 30 days.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145689 (fee description 'ALL campsites are by Reservations Only'; sites 6-12 'available through reservation only as well'; rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/sedalia-campground ('Group site one is available 12 months out for reservations and standard sites two through five are available for reservations for dates 6 months out'; 'Ensure you have a reservation before arrival'; 'All sites must be reserved through recreation.gov'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1-5 (four single sites and one group site) are open all year; a second loop, sites 6-12, opens only for deer season (Aug 28 - Jan 3) and turkey season in April.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/sedalia-campground ('Seasons of Use: All year'; 'Four single-family campsites and one group site are open year-round'; 'An additional camping loop is open for big game deer season from August 28th through January 3rd and during turkey season in April'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145689 (notice 'No hookups available'; 'The campground doesn't provide picnic tables, electricity, no hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Five year-round sites (group site 1, single sites 2-5) plus seven hunting-season sites (6-12, group site 8). Grassy primitive sites that 'vary in size but many will accommodate most any size RV's'; many take only one vehicle and one camper. RIDB driveway lengths 26-99 ft; one pull-through. No picnic tables.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145689 ('five year round primitive campsites and an additional seven seasonal campsites'; 'Campsites vary in size but many will accommodate most any size RV's, trailers and tents'; 'Many of these sites will only accommodate one vehicle with one camper') + RIDB campsite catalog (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20: 12 sites, driveway 26-99 ft, 1 pull-through), read 2026-10-21

values.note: One vault toilet; rock fire rings; no picnic tables; cell coverage sporadic. Drinking water is contradictory: recreation.gov lists 'one water spigot that is near the entrance', the Forest Service page says 'Potable water is not available at this site'.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10145689 ('one vault toilet, rock fire rings, trash receptable, and one water spigot'; 'no wifi') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/sedalia-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Forest Service (Enoree Ranger District) campground, not concession-run: confirmed $5/night (now manual) and year-round; booking reservation-only on recreation.gov (6 months for single sites), never first-come, 14 nights in 30; no hookups; 12 sites (5 year-round, 7 hunting-season), one pull-through; vault toilet, no Wi-Fi. Drinking water left unset (the two official pages disagree). No forest alert for Bombing Range Road (county 44-481) or SC 49. Note kept.
